brief: A resort hotel on the bluff above the bay: a three-storey cream-yellow brick block with white trim, a colonnaded two-storey entrance portico with a balcony, rows of sash windows under a bracketed cornice, a long porch, and a 1990s balconied wing behind. Four photos. Older than 1970: the grand resort hotel on the bay is a 19th-century type (the town's model). Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).
label: Tamsin Grand Hotel
